questions.question: What kind of memory does STARK AI use?
questions.golden_answer: STARK AI uses Mem0, an open-source memory layer for LLMs, with ChromaDB as the local vector database and Gemini embeddings for semantic search.

questions.question: List the action modules present in the project.
questions.golden_answer: The action modules include Google Gemini Live API for real-time voice, Mem0 for memory, ChromaDB for vector storage, Playwright for browser automation, Composio for third-party app integrations, and notebooklm-py for NotebookLM.

questions.question: Who developed STARK AI?
questions.golden_answer: STARK AI was developed by Sharda Vatsal Bhat (SVB).

questions.question: Which API powers the real-time voice conversation?
questions.golden_answer: The real-time voice conversation is powered by Google Gemini Live API with bidirectional audio streaming.

questions.question: What is the core purpose of STARK AI?
questions.golden_answer: STARK AI is a voice-controlled cross-platform AI personal assistant that sees the screen, controls the system, and automates tasks for PC and Android.

questions.question: What is the name of the personal AI assistant?
questions.golden_answer: The assistant is called STARK AI, also known as J.A.R.V.I.S.
